name: event-chip
title: Event chip
description: A calendar event small enough for a grid cell: a bar, the time and a title, in timed, all-day and multi-day styles, with a +3 more companion.
docs: event is { id, title, start, end, allDay, calendar, tone, tentative } and variant is timed (a bar and the start time), all-day or multi-day (a filled chip); it defaults from event.allDay. Tones are four steps of the page's own ink (ink, graphite, stone, mist): change the TONES table to use your brand's hues. The chip is one button whose name reads "Design review, 10:00 to 11:30, Studio", so colour is never the only signal, and a tooltip shows the whole title when it is cut. dense draws the 20px chip for a month grid and keeps that height inside a flex or grid column. For a multi-day event draw one chip per week row, place it with a grid column span, and set continuesBefore and continuesAfter where it carries on. OverflowChip is the "+3 more" under a crowded cell. Times use locale and timeZone.
